notes.title: More Fixes
notes.content:
Some more bugs come up so I fixed them aswell. I hope you are enjoying Babaguy so far! :D

[list]
[*] Made the achievements based on steam client data instead of local data
[*] Made the savemanager not reset all data if there was inconsistencies in the save data
[*] Renamed the reset data button
[/list]

notes.title: Initial Release Fixes
notes.content:
Some small bugs have come up with the release of the game so I fixed them. I hope you are enjoying Babaguy so far! :D

[olist]
[*] Invisible text fix
[*] Escape button messing up fix
[*] Bananaworld all coins achievement fix
[*] Piggy race achievement reset fix
[*] Made the temple slightly easier by adding a little delay on the spike trap and removing some traps from the level
[/olist]
